premises.text: Mobile fragmentation forces heavy testing spend on devices and people; cloud unit-test services leave developers with long error logs without the device in hand
premises.evidence_span: spending one third of your total development budget just on testing

premises.text: NativeTab puts real devices in a data center and lets developers interact with them lifelike from tablet/mobile/desktop as if on the desk, including debugger/USB-like workflows
premises.evidence_span: access those devices and interact with them as if they were on your desk

premises.text: Patent-pending low-latency I/O transfer, dense custom servers, demand-driven inventory/queuing, and cooling racks enable scalable multi-device access and higher margins
premises.evidence_span: patent pending input-output transfer technology that allows lifelike interaction with nearly zero latency

premises.text: Roadmap features include replicating touch events across cloud devices without writing unit tests and connecting remote IoT devices for app development
premises.evidence_span: test on one device and all of those touch events will be replicated on all of the devices in the cloud

value.text: Access any real mobile device anytime at a fraction of cost to save time, build better apps, and reach more markets
value.evidence_span: You save money. You can access any device anytime you want for a fraction of cost

causal_links.evidence_span: you're probably going to get bad review in the App Store
interact with real physical device as if it was on your desk
you don't have to now limit your target group simply because you can't afford to purchase all of those devices
